title: A Replacement Signed Up, but Hasn't Started Working Yet
summary: The agents swapped the guard on my Windows desktop without killing anything and registered a replacement root agent. The server turned it away over one field name, and the replacement hasn't done any work yet.
author: Alexey Grigorev
